narrative: 一件外套占满了镜头。等它离开，房间已经是后来的时刻，或者人已经不见了，或者街道已经变了样。
你需要一次观众感觉不到的剪辑。定格戏法式的早期电影，用锁定的摄影机加替身完成了这件事。
当代的一镜到底（Oner）则用挥镜、墙壁和拼接来完成。用它来模拟一个长镜头、让一个人凭空消失，或者在一次看似连续的行走中改变时间。
当这次剪辑应该像一句完整的句子时，这个手法就用错了——匹配剪辑（Match Cut）、硬切（Smash Cut）、划像转场（Wipe）才是那种句子。如果你想让这次衔接被看见，就不要把它藏起来。
这个戏法依赖于替换点周围的空间连续性。一个游移、不匹配的摄影机会暴露出一次意外的跳跃。
how: 规划一个藏身之处：一个经过的身影、一堵暗墙、一次挥镜造成的模糊、一扇位置吻合的门，或是在某种材质上做的数字拼接。如果要做替换，就要在不同镜头板之间锁定曝光和布光。
对于定格戏法，锁定摄影机，让演员保持不动，更换物体，在遮挡处完成拼接。对于一镜到底的错觉，要在挥镜处匹配好运动模糊和颗粒感。
提示词：invisible cut hidden in [Subject]'s whip, a dark wall, or a passing body, the oner illusion.
when: 用它来让一个长镜头贯穿一座剧院、一条战壕、一条街道，或者让一个女人从椅子上凭空消失。不要用它来逃避写一场真正的场景转换。
如果地理环境在你眼前真的发生了变化，那可能是场景转换（Set Transition），而不是一次隐藏的拼接。
vs: 一镜到底是你正在伪造或真正拍摄的长镜头。甩镜（Whip Pan）可以成为掩盖这次拼接的“绷带”。
动作匹配剪辑把一次剪辑藏在一个可辨识的动作里，但依然是有意改变视角。场景转换让场地本身重新改写自己。
匹配变形是一种可见的插值，恰恰是“隐形”的反面。
examples_film: 《消失的女人》（The Vanishing Lady）在两个画面之间替换了一位坐着的女人。《月球旅行记》（A Trip to the Moon）让月球人凭空消失。
《夺魂索》（Rope）把拼接点藏在暗色的前景中。《1917》和《鸟人》（Birdman）拼接出连续的行走，让战壕和剧院感觉一气呵成。
《007:幽灵党》（Spectre）的开场把多个空间呈现为一个镜头。这是关于隐藏的语法，而不是一个可以照搬的长镜头。
mistakes: 最常见的误用近亲是一次从未藏住拼接点的、明显的甩镜，或者一次匹配变形。破绽是：颗粒感突然一跳，人群里出现了跳跃，或者一堵墙在变形。
解决办法是：一个真正填满画面的遮挡物或模糊效果，布光要匹配，在这层遮挡内完成硬拼接，两侧的运动要保持连续。

faq.q: 电影中的“隐形剪辑”是什么？
faq.a: 隐形剪辑把剪辑点藏在运动、黑暗、遮挡、模糊、匹配的几何关系，或拼接手法之中。剪接点的两侧都要让人以为它们是同一个连续镜头。

faq.q: 隐形剪辑 vs 一镜到底
faq.a: 一镜到底是一个长镜头。隐形剪辑是你伪造或延长它的方式：拼接点藏在一次挥镜、一堵墙，或一个经过的身影之中。一个是表面上呈现的镜头；另一个是那道接缝。

faq.q: 什么时候该用隐形剪辑？
faq.a: 当观众绝不能感觉到剪辑时使用：一次消失的戏法、一段拼接而成的行走、一次看似连续路径中的时间跳跃。当这次衔接应该被观众察觉时，不要用它。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写隐形剪辑的提示词？
faq.a: 点明藏身之处以及两个镜头板。示例：Invisible cut hidden in [Subject]'s whip, a dark wall, or a passing body. 要求布光匹配，并且没有匹配变形。

narrative: A coat fills the lens. When it leaves, the room is later, or the body is gone, or the street has changed.
You needed a cut the audience must not feel. Stop-trick cinema did this with a locked camera and a substitution.
Contemporary oners do it with whips, walls, and stitches. Use it to simulate a long take, to vanish a person, or to change time inside an apparently continuous walk.
It is the wrong tool when the cut should be a sentence: a Match Cut, a Smash Cut, a Wipe. If you want the join seen, do not hide it.
The trick depends on spatial continuity around the substitution. A wandering unmatched camera exposes an unintended jump.
how: Plan a hiding place: a passing body, a dark wall, a whip-pan blur, a matched doorway, a digital stitch on a texture. Lock exposure and lighting across plates if you are substituting.
For a stop trick, lock the camera, hold actors, change the object, splice on the occlusion. For an oner illusion, match motion blur and grain at the whip.
Prompt: invisible cut hidden in [Subject]'s whip, a dark wall, or a passing body, the oner illusion.
when: Use it to extend a take through a theatre, a trench, a street, or to make a woman vanish from a chair. Do not use it to avoid writing a scene change.
If the geography actually transforms as you watch, that may be a Set Transition instead of a hidden splice.
vs: A Oner is the long take you are faking or actually shooting. A Whip Pan can be the bandage over the splice.
Match on Action hides a cut in a readable gesture but still changes the view on purpose. Set Transition lets the location rewrite itself.
Morph is a visible interpolation, the opposite of invisible.
examples_film: The Vanishing Lady substitutes a seated woman between frames. A Trip to the Moon pops Selenites out of existence.
Rope hides joins in dark foregrounds. 1917 and Birdman stitch walks so trenches and theatres feel continuous.
Spectre 's opening presents multiple spaces as one shot. Grammar of concealment, not a take to clone.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is a visible Whip Pan that never hides a join, or a morph. The tell: a pop in grain, a jump in crowd, a morphing wall.
The fix: a true occluder or blur that fills the frame, matched lighting, a hard splice inside that fill, continuous motion on both sides.

faq.q: What is Invisible Cut in film?
faq.a: An invisible cut hides the edit in motion, darkness, occlusion, blur, matching geometry, or stitching. Both sides of the join are meant to play as one continuous shot.
A oner is a long take. An invisible cut is how you fake or extend one: the splice sits inside a whip, a wall, or a passing body. One is the apparent shot; the other is the seam.

faq.q: When should I use Invisible Cut?
faq.a: Use it when the audience must not feel the edit: a vanishing act, a stitched walk, a time jump inside a continuous-looking path. Do not use it when the join should speak.

faq.q: How do I prompt Invisible Cut for AI image or video?
faq.a: Name the hiding place and both plates. Example: Invisible cut hidden in [Subject]'s whip, a dark wall, or a passing body. Demand matched lighting and no morph.
